title: Asset purchase — Prairie Fen Studios LLC
forum: Minnesota private asset purchase; no court proceeding

timeline.event: Buyer inspected the lunar model casting bench
Inventory count identified a cracked lunar model mold

documents.title: Asset purchase agreement excerpt
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Section 4.2 requires the buyer to deliver its inspection objection notice four calendar days after reset. Section 7.1 fixes closing twenty-four calendar days after reset. These are dates expressly written into the agreement, not statutory periods. Neither date moves for a weekend or holiday.

documents.title: Mold inventory and consent note
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The silver crescent mold has a hairline crack. Buyer wants a replacement credit before closing. The landlord consent is still a draft and does not yet authorize assignment of the workshop lease.

clientFacing.status: The purchase agreement is signed. We are resolving the cracked mold and obtaining the landlord’s signed consent.
nextSteps: Confirm whether you prefer a replacement mold or a price credit.
Review the objection notice before delivery and arrange the agreed closing funds.
